Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestTaiInstant_factory_of_UtcInstant.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestTaiInstant/TestTaiInstant_factory_of_UtcInstant.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original test contains a lot of dead code: five `data_*` provider methods and a `doTest_comparisons_TaiInstant` helper that no `@Test`/`@ParameterizedTest` ever references, plus many unused imports. The only executed test is `factory_of_UtcInstant`. I'll keep the runtime behaviour identical while removing the noise and clarifying the surviving test.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). I refactored `TestTaiInstant_factory_of_UtcInstant.java` for understandability — removed dead provider methods/helper and unused imports, renamed loop variables to meaningful names (`dayOffset`, `secondOfDay`), and introduced named constants (`MJD_TAI_EPOCH`, `SECONDS_PER_DAY`, `TAI_UTC_OFFSET_SECONDS`, etc.) — while keeping the same calls, arguments, and expected outcomes.
